spec.title: Codex, GLM and DeepSeek
spec.description: Calls that crok reported itself, for providers that export no traces of their own: OpenAI Codex (and any OpenAI API key), GLM (Z.ai, BigModel), DeepSeek, xAI and local models. Spend is what crok worked out per call; subscription plans show what the same calls would cost on the API.

list.name: model_re
list.label: Model (regex)
list.description: Filter by model, for example gpt-.* or deepseek-.*

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Calls crok made to these providers, failed and interrupted ones included, in the TUI and in Crok Desktop, on every machine that reports. Grafana Cloud runs a TraceQL metrics query over 25 hours at most, so keep the time range at 24 hours or less.

panels.title: Spend
panels.description: crok's figure for each call: the provider's own cost when it reports one (xAI), else the model's standard API price for the call's tokens (the table crok's /usage estimates with). Codex and GLM Coding Plan calls are paid by the subscription, so for them it is what the calls would cost on the API. crok 2.0.0 and older report no cost, so their calls are priced here from their tokens at the same standard API prices (prices.json), DeepSeek at its off-peak rate (its peak hours cost twice as much).

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Input plus output tokens. Input includes prompt-cache reads.

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of input tokens the provider read from its prompt cache. DeepSeek and GLM cache prompts by themselves; a low value in long sessions means the start of the prompt keeps changing. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of calls that failed. A call the user interrupted is not a failure (see Cancelled). Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of calls finished faster than this, from the request to the last streamed token (bucketed to powers of two). Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Cancelled
panels.description: Calls the user interrupted before the model finished (Esc, a new prompt, closing the session).

panels.title: Rate limited
panels.description: Calls refused with HTTP 429. Coding plans limit requests per few hours; this shows when you hit it.

panels.title: Unpriced calls
panels.description: Finished calls without a cost: the model is in neither crok's price list nor, for crok 2.0.0 and older, the dashboards' (prices.json). Spend leaves them out.

panels.title: Output speed
panels.description: Output tokens divided by call time over all calls. Call time includes reading the prompt, so long prompts lower it. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Avg prompt
panels.description: Average input tokens per call. It grows as a conversation gets longer. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Thinking share
panels.description: Share of output tokens the model spent thinking. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Week over week (recorded history, any time range)
Spend, week over week
panels.description: Spend in the last 7 days and how much more (or less, below zero) than the 7 days before. Last 7 days is the seven days up to the end of the time range; the 7 days before are the seven before that. Both come from the recorded history (LLM Spend History), which lags 20-30 minutes, and do not depend on the time range's length. All the providers on this dashboard; the filters above do not apply.

panels.title: Requests, week over week
panels.description: Calls in the last 7 days, compared with the 7 days before. Last 7 days is the seven days up to the end of the time range; the 7 days before are the seven before that. Both come from the recorded history (LLM Spend History), which lags 20-30 minutes, and do not depend on the time range's length. All the providers on this dashboard; the filters above do not apply.

panels.title: Tokens, week over week
panels.description: Input plus output tokens in the last 7 days, compared with the 7 days before. Last 7 days is the seven days up to the end of the time range; the 7 days before are the seven before that. Both come from the recorded history (LLM Spend History), which lags 20-30 minutes, and do not depend on the time range's length. All the providers on this dashboard; the filters above do not apply.

panels.title: Error rate, week over week
panels.description: Failed calls divided by all calls (a call the user interrupted in crok is not a failure). Last 7 days is the seven days up to the end of the time range; the 7 days before are the seven before that. Both come from the recorded history (LLM Spend History), which lags 20-30 minutes, and do not depend on the time range's length. All the providers on this dashboard; the filters above do not apply.

panels.title: Spend by model, week over week
panels.description: Spend per provider and model in the last 7 days and the 7 before. crok's figure for each call: the provider's own cost when it reports one (xAI), else the model's standard API price for the call's tokens (the table crok's /usage estimates with). Codex and GLM Coding Plan calls are paid by the subscription, so for them it is what the calls would cost on the API. crok 2.0.0 and older report no cost, so their calls are priced here from their tokens at the same standard API prices (prices.json), DeepSeek at its off-peak rate (its peak hours cost twice as much). Last 7 days is the seven days up to the end of the time range; the 7 days before are the seven before that. Both come from the recorded history (LLM Spend History), which lags 20-30 minutes, and do not depend on the time range's length.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, model) (label_replace(sum_over_time(llm_spend_usd{provider=~"codex|glm|deepseek|other"}[7d]), "model", "$1", "name", `"?streamText (.+?)"?`)) / sum by (provider, model) (label_replace(sum_over_time(llm_spend_usd{provider=~"codex|glm|deepseek|other"}[7d] offset 7d), "model", "$1", "name", `"?streamText (.+?)"?`)) - 1

panels.title: Requests by model, week over week
panels.description: Calls per provider and model in the last 7 days and the 7 before. Last 7 days is the seven days up to the end of the time range; the 7 days before are the seven before that. Both come from the recorded history (LLM Spend History), which lags 20-30 minutes, and do not depend on the time range's length.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, model) (label_replace(sum_over_time(llm_requests{provider=~"codex|glm|deepseek|other"}[7d]), "model", "$1", "name", `"?streamText (.+?)"?`)) / sum by (provider, model) (label_replace(sum_over_time(llm_requests{provider=~"codex|glm|deepseek|other"}[7d] offset 7d), "model", "$1", "name", `"?streamText (.+?)"?`)) - 1

Codex and GLM Coding Plan calls are paid by the subscription, so for them it is what the calls would cost on the API. crok 2.0.0 and older report no cost, so their calls are priced here from their tokens at the same standard API prices (prices.json), DeepSeek at its off-peak rate (its peak hours cost twice as much).

panels.title: Requests per day by model (last 14 days)
panels.description: Calls in each UTC day of the last 14 days, by model, from the recorded history.

panels.title: Spend by model
panels.description: Spend in each time bucket by model. The legend total is the spend over the range. crok's figure for each call: the provider's own cost when it reports one (xAI), else the model's standard API price for the call's tokens (the table crok's /usage estimates with). Codex and GLM Coding Plan calls are paid by the subscription, so for them it is what the calls would cost on the API. crok 2.0.0 and older report no cost, so their calls are priced here from their tokens at the same standard API prices (prices.json), DeepSeek at its off-peak rate (its peak hours cost twice as much).

panels.title: Spend by provider
panels.description: codex is OpenAI (Codex sign-in or an API key), glm is Z.ai and BigModel. crok's figure for each call: the provider's own cost when it reports one (xAI), else the model's standard API price for the call's tokens (the table crok's /usage estimates with). Codex and GLM Coding Plan calls are paid by the subscription, so for them it is what the calls would cost on the API. crok 2.0.0 and older report no cost, so their calls are priced here from their tokens at the same standard API prices (prices.json), DeepSeek at its off-peak rate (its peak hours cost twice as much).

panels.title: Spend by agent
panels.description: crok is the session's own turns, crok/<type> a sub-agent's, crok/side and the like crok's side calls (titles, summaries, permission checks). crok's figure for each call: the provider's own cost when it reports one (xAI), else the model's standard API price for the call's tokens (the table crok's /usage estimates with). Codex and GLM Coding Plan calls are paid by the subscription, so for them it is what the calls would cost on the API. crok 2.0.0 and older report no cost, so their calls are priced here from their tokens at the same standard API prices (prices.json), DeepSeek at its off-peak rate (its peak hours cost twice as much).

panels.title: Tokens by kind
panels.description: Input counts the whole prompt, cache reads and writes included, and output counts thinking, so the bars overlap rather than add up.

panels.title: Cache hit rate by model
panels.description: Share of each model's input read from the cache. A model that never read from it has no line.

panels.title: Call duration by model
panels.description: From sending the request to the last streamed token.

panels.title: Time to first token by provider
panels.description: How long the provider took to send the first token, from the agento11y SDK's gen_ai.client.time_to_first_token histogram (Prometheus).

panels.title: Output speed by model
panels.description: Output tokens per second of call time.

panels.title: Finish reasons
panels.description: stop / end_turn: finished. tool_calls / tool_use: asked for a tool. length / max_tokens: cut off. (not set): the call failed or was interrupted.

panels.title: Failures by category
panels.description: rate_limit (429), server_error (5xx), auth_error (401/403: sign in again), client_error (other 4xx), timeout, sdk_error (no HTTP status: the connection failed). Interrupted calls are left out.

panels.title: Requests by backend
panels.description: The API crok spoke: openai_codex (ChatGPT sign-in), glm, deepseek, responses or chat_completions (an API key), messages. (not set): crok releases before this report.

panels.title: Requests by agent
panels.description: The session's own turns (crok), sub-agents (crok/<type>) and side calls.

panels.title: Requests by surface
panels.description: tui (the terminal), desktop (Crok Desktop) or agent (another ACP client).

panels.title: Requests by machine
panels.description: The name of the Mac each call came from.

panels.title: Latest calls
panels.description: The most recent calls. Click a trace ID to open one: the span holds tokens, cost and, unless content capture is off, the conversation title. Cost (crok) is empty for crok 2.0.0 and older; the spend panels price those calls from their tokens. The prompts and replies are in Agent Observability.
